top_signals.title: Chile Peso Bonds Face Pressure if Strait of Hormuz Stays Closed
top_signals.summary: Chile’s peso borrowing costs risk hitting highs for the year in August as the Middle East conflict drags into its sixth month, even as the economy struggles to gain momentum.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Housebuilder shares rally on Iran war peace hopes and help-to-buy revival
top_signals.summary: Shares in leading London’s listed housebuilders jumped on Monday as investors bet a potential Iran war peace deal and a mooted new help-to-buy scheme would provide a boon to Britain’s flagging property market.
